slides.text:
5 workout hacks
I wish I knew earlier

1 — Warm up with your
first exercise

Just lighter

2 — Film your sets

Form fixes itself
once you see it

3 — Rest longer

Two minutes between sets
is not lazy

4 — Stop training
to failure

Leave two reps in the tank

slides.heading: 5 — Match training to recovery
slides.body: SOMA reads your sleep and strain — and tells you when to push and when to back off
